name: cc-tiers
description: Tiered Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku workflow: plan, delegate, retry, then escalate

max_attempts.title: Max attempts per tier
max_attempts.description: How many failures a task may have at one tier before it escalates (Haiku to Sonnet to Opus). A failure is a failed test, a rejected review, or a subagent error. Default 2.

review_policy.title: Opus review
review_policy.description: When finished work goes to the Opus reviewer. risky: non-trivial or risky changes. always: every passing task. never: no review pass.

trivial_extra.title: Extra Haiku phrases
trivial_extra.description: Comma-separated phrases that also count as trivial Haiku work, added to the built-in list. Example: changelog edits, license year bumps.

risky_extra.title: Extra review phrases
risky_extra.description: Comma-separated phrases that also require an Opus review, added to the built-in risky list. Example: terraform, billing.
